name: Waupaca County, WI
findings: Waupaca County has 179 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Waupaca County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 10 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
